# clickup_time_entry (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (Number) Workspace ID
- `timer_id` (String) The ID of a time entry. \
 \
This can be found using the [Get Time Entries Within a Date Range](ref:gettimeentrieswithinadaterange) endpoint.

### Optional

- `include_approval_details` (Boolean) Include the details of the approval for the time entry.
- `include_approval_history` (Boolean) Include the history of the approval for the time entry.
- `include_location_names` (Boolean) Include the names of the List, Folder, and Space along with `list_id`,`folder_id`, and `space_id`.
- `include_task_tags` (Boolean) Include task tags in the response for time entries associated with tasks.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
